title: BUG: slot_remove_flash leaks keystore when drive departs while logged in
description: slot_remove_flash and slot_remove_flash_dir (src/wp11_pkcs11.c lines ~410-463) invalidate sessions and clear token_present but do not free g_slots[i].keystore. If the user was logged in when the USB drive was removed, the keystore (with mlock'd key material) is never freed until C_Finalize. C_Logout cannot recover it because sessions were invalidated (logged_in==0 so C_Logout returns CKR_USER_NOT_LOGGED_IN without entering the keystore-free path). Consequence: mlock pages stay pinned; on embedded systems with tight RLIMIT_MEMLOCK this causes the next wp11_keystore_load to fail with WP11_KEYSTORE_ERR_MLOCK. Fix: in slot_remove_flash, before clearing token_present, call flash_slot_clear_keys(i) then wp11_keystore_free(g_slots[i].keystore) and NULL the pointer. Same for slot_remove_flash_dir. Add inline comment explaining why the clear-then-free ordering matters (same as C_Finalize).
